g.text: The second cut starts with the blade still pointing
the way the first cut went (to the right): the tip
drags off the line until the ramp lines it up.
Now: turn in place, then ramp
The tip lands on the start, the blade turns there
(shallow), then ramps in already lined up. The first
cut of a program can’t know which way it points.
holder (spindle) path; dotted in the air
